statistical_method.four_repeat_ci: exp(mean log ratio +/- t(0.975, df=3) * sample SD(log ratio)/sqrt(4))
statistical_method.block_sensitivity_ci: average the two pair log ratios within each block, then t(0.975, df=1) interval over the two block averages

two blocks are not independent host replications

CPU/memory are shared-host observational diagnostics; no isolated proxy cost or causal effect

source_and_log_limitations: Canonical files have no per-file expected digest or workload revision supplied by the harness; independently computed SHA-256 and exact GitHub artifact digest establish the evidence identity.
Observed index omits run/block provenance; unique whole-object matching to paths restores it for this dataset.
No client/backend executable hash, generated certificate fingerprint or full runtime container inspection in artifact.
Only Envoy runtime config is archived and verified against exact static materialization; other gateway config claims are source-contract provenance.
Kong/Tyk/Redis pull digests recovered from hosted logs; raw images.txt only includes Ferrum and Envoy.
Ferrum image IDs differ across protocol hosts; within each host identical across blocks; common git SHA is not byte-identical cross-host image proof.
remaining_issue_obligations: Keep #5588 open: this bounded missing-payload audit does not complete the tracker.
WSS 5 MiB failure signature and smaller payload/long-lived-stream behavior are outside this 512000/1048576 matrix; do not claim their repair from these rows.

Reconcile tracker historical flush checkbox with existing repair and retained rustls test; causal mapping of historical hosted timeouts still requires separate exact evidence, not these observational rates.
Retain and resolve the Tyk startup/Redis and Envoy teardown/reset uncertainties; obtain phase-qualified transport/drop and missing service capture if required for a transport-clean comparison.
Same-host baseline/candidate revision experiment and sufficiently replicated host/block uncertainty remain absent; four gateway repeats do not substitute for a code A/B.
No kernel/socket-drop, per-worker CPU, syscall/allocation/copy/TLS-record or relay-state profiling here; no new production change is justified by correlation.
Broader issue H1 framing, H2/gRPC failure/guard, H3 transport fairness and UDP directions remain governed by their own evidence; not assessed or closed here.

scope: All 72 expected canonical rows; descriptive useful-work comparisons only. No fully verified transport cleanliness or causal code A/B gain.
retention_note: Paths identify files inside the combined GitHub Actions artifact. The committed inventory and compact observations remain after Actions artifact expiry; raw artifacts are not bundled here. Missing raw evidence must not be treated as revalidated.
omitted_raw_detail: Full raw samples, individual process timeline rows, per-record Envoy snapshots and logs stay in the hash-inventoried artifact. This compact publication retains every sample, validation disposition, process summary, phase scalar and comparison.

diagnostic_findings.finding: 72/72 request-valid and process-bracket-valid samples; zero client stderr, exact useful/drain byte totals and conserved admitted work
diagnostic_findings.limits: transport-cleanliness and production-fix efficacy not established

diagnostic_findings.finding: Tyk: 8 structured Redis startup errors, 6 warnings and 1 TLS-handshake EOF per four process startups; post-sample log equals startup log for both sizes
diagnostic_findings.limits: Redis recovery cause and runtime health unproven; no Redis logs/process capture; readiness TCP probe plausible for EOF, not trace-proven

diagnostic_findings.finding: Envoy WSS: cumulative receive resets and connection destruction 200 after 512000, 300 after 1048576 in each of four sessions; TCP: remote active-request destruction likewise 200/300
diagnostic_findings.limits: aligns cumulative worker connections and teardown but no phase-bracketed delta/event times; do not sum snapshots or classify as measured useful-request errors

diagnostic_findings.finding: Kong super-user directive warning twice per startup; TCP stream logs cumulative 401/601 entries all status 200
diagnostic_findings.limits: TCP stream status and TLS/wire counters are not client useful-echo request counts

diagnostic_findings.finding: Backend logs contain startup banner only; Ferrum and Envoy gateway/startup logs empty
diagnostic_findings.limits: backend source suppresses per-connection WSS/TCP errors; quiet gateway/error-level logs do not prove absence of failures

diagnostic_findings.finding: No local/repository execution, mutations, review, dispatch or implementation performed
diagnostic_findings.limits: source tests were read only; retained historical findings not newly executed
